notes: Fixes the Settings crash: Muse's Settings screen asks Android whether Muse is the default assistant (RoleManager.isRoleHeld); the real role service rejected the clone because it runs under DevxyzMuse's uid, and the SecurityException killed the clone. The container now answers role queries itself (a clone never holds a system role), so Settings opens normally. Also guards a GMS bind race that could crash a clone process. Installs in place - clones and sign-ins are preserved.
